visible_text: マイクと 画面の音を聞いています
決まったことを待っています...
やることを待っています...
まだ発話がありません。
この会議について聞く
AI が関わっている機能 — まだありません

answers.q1: A meeting recording has just started (2 seconds in). The app is actively capturing audio from microphone and screen, waiting to detect speech for transcription and analysis.
answers.q2: The active recording status (red indicator + 00:02 timer) and the meeting title '02:58 の会議'. The system confirms it is listening but has detected no speech yet.
answers.q3: The interface offers buttons to ask questions about the meeting, view transcription, translate, add captions, and panels for decisions and action items will populate as content is captured.
answers.q4: Yes. The red recording indicator is active, the timer is running, and the system explicitly states it's listening to microphone and screen audio. It correctly waits for speech before populating summary/decision sections.
answers.q5: The 'まだ発話がありません' (no speech yet) message is honest but premature. The empty 'decisions' and 'action items' sections are placeholders that clutter the early-stage view. The three-dot menu in the control bar may not be essential at launch.
answers.q6: The red recording dot and elapsed timer bar (top-left), followed by the meeting title '02:58 の会議', then the recording status confirmation text below.

weaknesses.what: Too many empty placeholder sections visible at launch (decisions, actions, summary). Wastes visual space and creates cognitive load.
weaknesses.fix: Hide or collapse empty sections in the early state. Introduce them only when content becomes available, or show a single status area instead.

weaknesses.what: 'AI が関わっている機能 — まだありません' is discouraging. Honest but pessimistic tone for a new user.
weaknesses.fix: Replace with encouraging language: 'AI features activate when speech is detected' or 'Ready to capture and analyze your meeting'.

weaknesses.what: Unclear what the user should do during recording. No guidance on whether to speak now, wait, or adjust anything.
weaknesses.fix: Add subtle instruction or status: 'Recording... speak naturally' or show a visual cue that recording is ready for input.

weaknesses.what: Right panel is largely empty; visual weight is unbalanced between left (content) and right (analysis panels).
weaknesses.fix: Either streamline the right panel to show only active elements, or move secondary controls elsewhere to avoid wasted space.
